presentation.notesHTML:
Calidorian Stellar Atlas v.03 · 134 CE

Sources and additions

The 33-system roster and relative positions follow the supplied map. Calidor replaces Grayson; the former name remains searchable. Hubris, Contempt, Edict and Anathema preserve their black-hole identities. Hubris B and Contempt B are stellar companions. Existing named worlds and facilities are retained; small raster labels including Marias, Giava, Emberhald, Tyrides, Valus, Eurelia, Bracus and Ophir are provisional transcriptions.

The Dominion of Calidor article establishes the capital, Dominion City, Cassianite monarchy and Foundry. The six regions form contiguous chart divisions. This edition adds three systems to each of the five original regions and five systems in Sanctum Reach. Additional planets, all moon inventories, most stations, stellar subclasses and extra multiple-star configurations are first-pass creative additions, not claims of published Codex canon.

Navigation

Drag to pan; scroll or pinch to zoom. Click regional space to highlight it, or use the dropdown to open a regional chart. Regional view contains no orbital diagrams. Double-click a system to enter; double-click a planet to explore satellites. Names open their corresponding Codex articles, including intended pages that do not yet exist. Index starts collapsed. Escape returns to the parent view.

Orbital views

Every planet has moons. Only major moons and selected stations appear in system view; all local satellites appear in planetary view. Orbital positions, speeds, sizes and inclinations are schematic. Black-hole systems use illustrative stable distant orbits. Station categories can be filtered. The Foundry’s glyph is a schematic interpretation, not a canonical construction drawing.

Labels and embeds

Overview names appear at 135%, or 100% in a highlighted region. Planet sublabels appear at 195%, or 155% highlighted. Regional charts use 64% / 80% for active names / sublabels. Compact displays scale these thresholds to available space.

Widgets: ?view=widget&system=calidor, ?view=widget&planet=Calidor, or ?view=widget&region=crown. Region keys: genesis, concordance, crown, edict, vesper, sanctum. Widget bodies and headers link to the Codex. MediaWiki EmbedMap may pass parameters through window.SKYRIVER_ATLAS_QUERY.

Live Codex data

Available article images and infobox facts can refresh online. Missing or inaccessible articles retain the local atlas entry. The complete map and bundled flag work offline.
